purpose: Machine-readable manufacture/install/material/LOD contract for the benchmark-visible circa-2000 neighborhood park lamp. Source-side compliance is implementation readiness only; Visual Fidelity points require actual native Unity renders.
periodIntent: ordinary Japanese neighborhood/municipal park globe lamp plausible around 2000; not a claim of one exact manufacturer model

referenceBasis.topic: lighting-pole taper as a construction class
referenceBasis.useInModel: supports the general physical principle that lighting poles may taper continuously from a larger base diameter to a smaller top diameter; the source describes steel road-lighting poles and is not treated as historical dimensional evidence for this fictional concrete park pole
supports modeling the pole-top/luminaire connection as a real diameter/insertion interface rather than a floating decorative head; no exact product compatibility is claimed

referenceBasis.topic: ordinary Japanese neighborhood park globe-lamp morphology
referenceBasis.useInModel: visual-morphology reference only: a simple tall pole with a retained globe is a real municipal-park form; the current photograph is not used as proof of a 2000 product specification

assembly.orientation: local +Y is vertical; the service cover faces local +Z toward the benchmark-camera side
assembly.exposure: full midsummer sun and rain; upper cap and globe receive direct exposure, while the lowest 0.20 m above grade receives splash/capillary darkening
assembly.manufacture: continuous tapered spun/precast-concrete visual pole shell; curved weather-sealed service cover; inserted painted-metal top adapter; lower and upper globe retainers plus weather cap; separately lathed aged dielectric globe
installationSequence: concrete pole continues 0.08 m below visible grade so the hero shell cannot float
pole tapers continuously from 0.190 m diameter at grade to 0.125 m diameter at the 3.92 m top
curved EPDM gasket follows the pole surface around the service opening zone
curved painted service cover bears on the gasket; four small cover fasteners are retained only at LOD0
painted adapter stem inserts 0.002 m into the pole top and 0.002 m into the lower globe retainer
lower retainer overlaps the lower diffuser neck by 0.005 m
upper retainer overlaps the upper diffuser neck by 0.005 m
weather cap bears directly on the upper retainer

components.name: continuous concrete pole
components.geometry: tapered lathed/frustum shell, 32/24/16/12 radial segments in LOD0/1/2/3

components.name: causal moisture zone
components.geometry: same continuous pole surface via a lower material submesh; never a protruding ring

causeBasedAging: lowest 0.20 m of concrete may darken/roughen from splash and capillary moisture without changing macro geometry
sun-exposed paint may chalk slightly while sheltered underside regions remain darker
globe may show diffuse UV haze and wiping micro-scratches but no directional baked highlight
retainer/cap runoff edges may collect fine contamination; random full-surface dirt is forbidden

contactConcrete.microstructure: same mineral substrate with moisture/splash roughness

diffuser.microstructure: frosted polymer/glass-like scattering proxy plus subtle wiping haze
diffuser.angularFresnel: dielectric; highlights/reflections must arise from lighting

lod.criticalFail: visible silhouette/material-class pop or detached head/service-cover hardware

criticalAutomaticFail: visible primitive-placeholder geometry in benchmark framing
daytime emissive or lit park globe

requiredEvidence: native 3840x2160 benchmark frame where the lamp is visible
100% crop showing continuous pole taper and grade contact without a protruding fake moisture ring
100% crop showing curved service cover/gasket bearing and real cover fasteners where resolvable
oblique/grazing evidence showing concrete, painted retainers, exposed fasteners and aged dielectric globe separate by actual Fresnel/roughness
temporal sequence traversing lamp LOD thresholds without silhouette/material-class pop
renderVerification.scoringRule: source-side QA cannot award Geometry, Material/PBR, Weathering, Period Accuracy or Temporal/LOD points
